summary: Abits Group Inc, a Hong Kong-domiciled Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin miner (ABTS), furnished a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, carrying interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and a same-day earnings press release rather than a transaction announcement. Revenue fell roughly 20% to $3.20 million; direct costs rose 48% to $2.76 million; pre-tax loss widened to about $2.54 million from $0.34 million. Treasury BTC rose 54% to 24.67 coins. Disclosed subsequent events include a February 24, 2026 approximately $2.1 million share and pre-funded warrant financing, a September 14, 2026 convertible note purchase agreement of $16,470,588.24 principal for up to $14,000,000 payable in three tranches, and October 6, 2026 board changes installing Stephen Faucetta as CEO and Chairman. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings filing with financing and governance updates, not a standalone special situation; the new CEO/CFO change is embedded disclosure, not the filing's event. Watch dilution from the note and tranche draws, BTC price sensitivity, and Memphis hosting cost progression.
